prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: Before 2024, it was the **women’s 1,500-meter freestyle**. Ledecky had broken that event’s world record **four times**, second only to her record-breaking streak in the 800-meter freestyle.
